nursery_days.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
nursery_days.quote: Transplant 40 - 45 days old seedlings at a spacing of 45 cm.

days_to_first_harvest.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
days_to_first_harvest.note: 105 days from transplanting - 35 days of harvesting = first harvest at about 70 days. From the TNAU fertigation schedule: total duration minus the harvesting stage = first picking.

spacing_row_cm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
spacing_row_cm.quote: Ridges and furrows are formed at 45 cm apart

spacing_plant_cm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
spacing_plant_cm.quote: Transplant 40 - 45 days old seedlings at a spacing of 45 cm.

water_need.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
water_need.note: Interpreted: watering once a week is read as 'low', every few days as 'medium', a continuous supply as 'medium' to 'high'; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

source_notes: AI research batch 5 (2026-10-06). Ranges are stored at their lower bound; the source range is in each quote. Sow windows are TNAU plains months (Tamil Nadu) until a Malwa source is found.

sow_windows.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
sow_windows.note: Sowing months shifted by the 40 nursery days to the transplant date; cut at 31 December.
